The '''''MedStar Nineteen''''' was a [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched this [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] to aid the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Rimsoo]] facilities on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].
